'''Osana''' is a Lady from [[Arad Doman]].

== Appearance ==
She is  dark-haired, not young, but with a pale beauty and elegance.

== Activities ==
She was first seen as [[Graendal]]'s servant serving her and [[Sammael]] wine punch. She has disappeared recently. [[Rodel Ituralde]] uses her hunting lodge to meet with [[Dragonsworn]].
